reviewed_by: Codex review of the October 13 VPN selection mobile WebKit release failure
reason: The operator selects a saved VPN profile from Advanced Settings and sees the project policy become In use. The v3.0.10 WebKit trace showed sticky Settings tabs intercepting Playwright's offscreen click and no policy PUT. The focused browser test now waits for the Advanced section, verifies its Automation disclosure opens, scrolls the action into a clear tap target, checks the hit target and Core request, then verifies the saved selection. Five relevant desktop and phone profiles cover mouse and touch at the affected widths. Core's project automation policy is authoritative; the test uses a bounded API fixture.
exclusions: This test-only change excludes unrelated settings, real Core, Python, frontend unit, native, and the full suite. It does not change the VPN product flow or claim persistence beyond the existing mock fixture; the release's real-Core and package gates remain separate.
